reference.method: Independent commands with loaded chunks and timed snapshots; no upgrades; default settings.

blocked.no_water: After 100 ticks input and 10000 EU unchanged, progress 0.
blocked.all_three_output_slots_full: After 1200 ticks input, 1000 mB water, output stacks and 10000 EU unchanged, progress 0.

centrifuge.interruption: In the initially hot, 20000-EU sample, work reached progress 399 with 449 EU left; after running out of energy the progress reset to 0 and the input remained. Heat then declined.
centrifuge.caveat: The 150000-EU value was directly seeded to observe the full operation and is not a measurement of the machine's actual storage capacity.
centrifuge.blocked: With all three output stacks full, an initially cold machine remains cold without spending energy; a 1000-heat machine falls to 901 over 100 ticks without spending its 10000 EU; input and progress remain.

heat_threshold_boundary.seed_50000: Next tick heat 49999, no progress or air consumption.
heat_threshold_boundary.seed_50001: Next tick heat 50000, progress 1, air -1 mB.

blast_furnace.air_and_completion: With ample heat and air, progress 5999 completes on the next working tick, consumes 1 mB air and produces both outputs; direct seeded-boundary result, not a complete continuous-run duration measurement.
blast_furnace.alignment: A solid heat generator west of the furnace facing east supplies heat when the furnace faces west; north/south/east furnace orientations at the same relation did not heat in the 100-tick sample.
blast_furnace.status: Cold-start continuous heat supply, compressed air and successful full steel batch observed. The 6000-tick full natural duration was not directly timed from first to last working tick.

natural_run.heat_source: solid_heat_generator west, facing east; furnace facing west
natural_run.duration: Full natural operation completed; individual first-to-last work ticks were not measured.

blast_furnace.blocked: Full two-slot output: input and 6000 mB air remain, progress 0 after 100 ticks. Even preset progress 5999 resets to 0. With no air, input and progress remain but active flag may be true at high heat.

solid_heat_source.caveat: A single ash outcome is not a probability estimate.
